responsibility: Collects the public function and data declarations for the rs6000 backend and its companion source files. It exposes the main code-generation, addressing, vector expansion, builtin-resolution, ABI, assembly-output, target-hook, Linux/D front-end, and pass-construction helpers implemented across powerpcspe.c, powerpcspe-c.c, and related files, and serves as the shared interface that other backend files and generated machine-description code include when calling rs6000 routines.
